question: What is the colour of the antenna used on the volleyball net?
solution:
The correct answer is **Red and white**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Court size:** A volleyball court is rectangular, measuring 18 meters long and 9 meters wide.
 
• **Net height:** The net is raised to a height of 2.43 meters for men and 2.24 meters for women.
 
• **Scoring:** Points can be scored by serving the ball over the net and forcing the opposing team to make an error.
 
• **Rotation:** After winning a serve, the serving team rotates one player clockwise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **FIVB World Cup:** This is the most prestigious international volleyball tournament. The trophy is a silver cup with a volleyball on top.
 
• **Olympic Games:** Volleyball is a popular Olympic sport. The gold medal is a laurel wreath with the Olympic rings.
 
• **Volleyball Hall of Fame:** This is a prestigious honour for volleyball players and coaches. The inductees are recognized for their contributions to the sport.
 
• **Famous volleyball players:** Some famous volleyball players include Karch Kiraly (USA), Lang Ping (China), and Gabi Garcia (Brazil).
